features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — No migration. From this version the log of every title transfer, which already existed, carries two more pieces of information: which instalment plans its settlement took and, with the waiver or with the settlement cancelled, how much the parties settled between themselves. There is a single theme: after a transfer, every share must be sorted out by only one of the two routes — the recalculation of the plan or the settlement of the transfer —, never by both; where neither of the two can do it, the share stays in the name of whoever held it and the panel says so. Up to .41, in some cases the buyer paid their days twice, the seller received a credit on shares that were never theirs, or the buyer's days stayed charged to the seller without either route moving them.

CHANGED: A TRANSFER TAKES INTO ITS SETTLEMENT THE PLANS THAT THE RECALCULATION REFUSES, AND ONLY THOSE — The recalculation already refused because of a share posted to the journal or a movement; the settlement instead took «issued» instalments and plans with shares posted to the journal. An «issued» instalment with no shares posted to the journal (issuing wrote that status even on an instalment made only of credit shares) thus ended up sorted out by both routes; a plan with a payment on an instalment still in draft, by neither. Now there is a single rule, for both: a plan with a share posted to the journal, or with a payment, a used credit or a refund on one of its shares, is not recalculated, and a transfer takes it into its settlement. An instalment with no shares to pay no longer becomes «issued», and the issuing message says so.

CHANGED: THE PLAN TAKEN BY A TRANSFER'S SETTLEMENT STAYS AS IT IS — It is not recalculated, not deleted and does not lose an item, even after the reversal of the payment that had stopped it, and the next transfer in turn takes it into its settlement. The Wallet balances it absorbed also keep the lock and can be neither edited nor deleted: up to .41, once the payment was reversed, they became editable again. Cancelling the settlement means the parties have settled between themselves, and the plan stays frozen. To recalculate it, first remove its shares posted to the journal and its movements, if it has any, then cancel the transfer from its unit's history, record it again and recalculate; a removed movement is recorded again after the recalculation. With a transfer recorded before this version the order is different, and the messages say so. If the parties had already settled between themselves — with the waiver or by cancelling the settlement — the message says so, with the figure when the waiver or the cancellation were made with this version: when recalculating, the building charges the incoming person for their days, and that agreement must be redone between the parties. The start of a lease and the end of a lease without a new tenant have no settlement and take no plan, as in .41, even when they were recorded with earlier versions.

CHANGED: A PLAN THAT STILL HAS TO FOLLOW A SALE OR A USUFRUCT IS RECALCULATED BEFORE ISSUING — A sale or a usufruct recorded when the plan could still be recalculated does not take it into its settlement: it leaves it to the recalculation. Up to .41 it could be issued anyway, and at the next transfer the seller received a credit on shares that were never theirs (€ 1,006.03 on an expense of € 1,200.00). Now issuing, payment, offset and refund on one of its shares are refused until the plan is recalculated, and the message says which transfer it has to follow; the message for payment, offset and refund also says which plan to recalculate. After the start of a lease or a change of tenant, issuing and payment are not refused, as up to .41: a plan issued without recalculation leaves the tenant's shares to whoever held them when it was calculated, the owner or the previous tenant. On those shares, and on plans already issued without recalculation with earlier versions (whose remaining instalments are issued and collected as before), the settlement of the next transfer stops and says so, with the tick in the gate, even when the law would leave that expense to the person leaving anyway.

CHANGED: THE TRANSFER CARRIES THE WHOLE SHARE OF THE PERSON LEAVING — The «The share changes» checkbox is gone: no figure other than the share of the person leaving had a correct outcome (Elsa at 100 % who «sells 50» to Carlo: the split charged Carlo the other half too). Selling part of one's own share, with the seller staying on the part they keep, comes later; until then the message explains how to record it by hand.

CHANGED: CANCELLING THE ISSUING OF AN INSTALMENT — It is no longer blocked by a transfer recorded from this version: the plan taken stays frozen anyway, and the re-issued instalment has the same shares. For transfers recorded with earlier versions the guard remains, but it looks at the plan and no longer at the two rows of the settlement: it refuses when the transfer was recorded after the instalment was issued, even if there was a waiver or the settlement was cancelled. Up to .41, in those two cases cancelling the issuing went through, and cancelling the settlement was the route indicated to unblock it; not any more. It no longer refuses because of a transfer that did not take that plan, even if it has the pair on the same management. The message says which transfer to cancel first and in what order.

FIXED: THE BUYER PAID THEIR DAYS TWICE — It happened when the plan had an «issued» instalment made only of credit shares: the settlement wrote the pair and the later recalculation divided by days again (€ 179.73 on an expense of € 1,200.00).

FIXED: A PAYMENT ON A DRAFT INSTALMENT LEFT THE DAYS WITH THE SELLER — With a payment on an instalment still in draft the opposite happened: the settlement did not take the plan, the recalculation refused because of the payment, and the buyer's days stayed charged to the seller until the payment was cancelled. Now the settlement takes the plan.

FIXED: THE ROUTE TO RECALCULATE AFTER THE CREATION OF A USUFRUCT — After the creation of a usufruct with the law, the route indicated to recalculate silently moved the ordinary expenses from the usufructuary to the bare owner.

FIXED: THE END OF A USUFRUCT ON THE SAME DAY AS THE SALE OF THE BARE OWNERSHIP — When the bare owner bought the bare ownership on the same day, and already held full ownership of another part, the two parts are added up in a single row. If full ownership also arrived that day, the end of the usufruct is refused and says in what order to cancel and record the transfers again, also with two sellers of the bare ownership or with the same seller. In the rarest cases the refusal states the fact and refers to correction by hand: a full row associated by hand, a transfer recorded together with an appurtenance, a sale or donation with reserved usufruct, a transfer in which the bare owner leaves, a sale of the bare ownership or a transfer in favour of the bare owner with a later date. Before, the end of the usufruct was recorded anyway and turned into full ownership the bare ownership born that day without looking at the full ownership already present, leaving two open and overlapping full rows, on the unit and on the ticked appurtenances.
FIXED: AN END OF USUFRUCT WITH A DATE BEFORE THE SALE OF THE BARE OWNERSHIP — It is refused and says so: before, whoever had sold the bare ownership silently remained full owner.
FIXED: THE CREATION AND THE END OF THE USUFRUCT — They add up the rows of the same role, like the sale, in the cancellation too.

FIXED: THE WARNING ABOUT THE OTHER USUFRUCTS OF THE MANAGEMENT — The choice of who pays the ordinary expenses also affects another usufruct of the same management, and now the transfer panel says so before confirmation. The choice acts on the item, and the item applies to the whole year of the management: choosing the law, in plans generated or recalculated afterwards the ordinary expenses of the moved item go to the usufructuary also for the days of a usufruct created «as each item says», even if already ended. The panel names that usufruct, with the unit and the dates, and to leave the item to the bare owner it is enough to untick it. Up to .41 the outcome was the same, but the panel did not say so. It applies to usufructs recorded from 1.11.0-beta.41, the first version that records the choice.

FIXED: THE END OF A LEASE WITHOUT A NEW TENANT — The panel promised a settlement that is not calculated: the shares not yet issued in the tenant's name, in a plan that can no longer be recalculated, appeared as «included in the settlement». Now the panel says they stay in the tenant's name, without a settlement, and that who pays the days after the end of the lease is decided by the administrator, if needed with a manual balance from the Wallet on the same management.

FIXED: MESSAGES THAT REFERRED TO EACH OTHER — Cancelling a transfer no longer advises cancelling the settlement first: it is no longer needed, because cancelling an issuing made after the transfer is no longer refused because of that transfer. When the pair has already been absorbed by another issued plan, the message gives two routes, first the short one (the transfer stays and the plan is issued as it is), then the complete one.

FIXED: THE SENTENCES GIVE THE REAL REASON WHY A PLAN IS NOT REWRITTEN — Shares posted to the journal, a payment, a credit used or refunded, the settlement of a transfer: in the refusal, in the transfer panel, in the Wallet and on the «Recalculate» button, with the remedy for each; they name the transfers with their unit, only once even with appurtenances, and in the plural when there is more than one. The locked-balance box suggests cancelling the issuings only when that is really needed.

FIXED: REFUSALS CAN BE READ ONE PIECE AT A TIME — The refusal to cancel an issuing put the transfers in a row in a single sentence, all centred: now it is left-aligned, with the transfers in a list and the steps to follow numbered, in the order in which they must be done. The new issuing refusal has the same form: when the recalculation is also frozen, the steps go as far as the recalculation and recording the cancelled movement again. The same goes for the warning of the «Recalculate» button, which before only said «cancel the issuings first» and now gives the reason why the plan is frozen, the transfers and the steps to reopen it.

FIXED: A REFUSED ISSUING OR REMOVAL LOOKED SUCCESSFUL — When the program did not issue — for example with the resolution date of an extraordinary plan corrected after the shares were calculated, or without the ledger accounts for the instalments — the dialog said «Issuing complete» with the number of instalments chosen, and the reason disappeared. Removing an item from a plan that is not rewritten likewise said «Item removed». Now the dialog states the refusal and the reason, and the item's bin is disabled while the plan is frozen. When issuing succeeds, the outcome counts the instalments actually posted to the journal, and an issuing that posts none («No instalment issued») is shown as a warning, not as a success.

FIXED: THE INSTALMENT PLAN PAGE IN DARK THEME — It stayed half light (the totals boxes, the expense coverage, the table and the instalment cells, the budget history): now they are dark too. The light theme does not change.

FIXED: THE WALLET ON THE PHONE — Below 768 px of width the list of units and the detail alternate, with «Back to the list» always in view, instead of the detail squeezed next to the list. The role reads «bare owner», not the internal name of the field.

SECURITY — Creating an instalment plan accepts only the management, invoices, items, balances and people of the building in the address, and the refusal message says nothing about another building — not a figure, nor a document number, nor the nature of a management. Issuing considers only the plan's instalments, and «Publish hidden» only a plan of the building in the address: up to .41, with an address typed by hand, it made the instalments issued without notification visible to the residents of another building.

THE GUIDES — The transfer guide explains when a plan is recalculated and when the settlement takes it, the whole share, how to record by hand the sale of part of a share, what cancelling the settlement means and how a taken plan is reopened. The instalment plan guide gives the three cases in which recalculation is blocked, that a draft plan can be frozen, and cancelling issuings when there are transfers; the Wallet guide, how a balance is corrected according to the reason why the plan is frozen, when the lock applies (also for the settlement of a transfer) and that a plan with issued instalments cannot be deleted until the issuings are cancelled, which the «Dati Blindati» box on the page now says too. The guide to the list of plans says that the dates of a plan already created cannot be changed; «Roles and usufruct» says when a plan can no longer be recalculated.

NOT YET — Succession, which beta.41 announced for this version: it comes with beta.44. The end of one of two usufructs on the same unit also makes full owner again the bare owner of the part on which the other usufruct continues, and part of the settlement also goes to that bare owner; it is fixed with beta.43. Some chains of transfers on the same unit — after an ended or reserved usufruct, with two transfers by the same person on the same day, with an appurtenance that has a different bare owner or has stayed partly with a co-owner — can still give a wrong settlement, or stop it where the part that passes is certain: they are fixed with beta.43. On a plan without breakdown detail (generated before 1.11.0-beta.29), the resale of the bare ownership after a creation «as each item says» is not settled: the reseller loses the part of the buyer's days (€ 401.10 on an expense of € 1,200.00); it is fixed with beta.43. The start of a lease on a plan already frozen: the tenant's part from the day of the contract stays with the owner, while the panel still announces that from that day the items charged to the tenant change holder (it is fixed with the version dedicated to leases). Selling part of one's own share. A transfer within a chain may round by a few cents differently from the calculation on the whole management.

FOR DEVELOPERS — PianoRate::eImmutabile() = journal entry, movement (importo_pagato ≠ 0) or settlement of a transfer (conguagliato()); immutabiliFra() for sets; ragioniDelFermo(), fraseDelFermo(), rimediDelFermo(). passaggiDaSeguire() (sale and usufruct only) for the guard on issuing (EmissioneRateController::fraseDaRicalcolare()) and on payment, offset and refund (fraseRicalcolaPrima(); payment and offset raise it as PianoDaRicalcolareException, refund as a validation error on rata_quote_id). ragioniInParole(), vociDeiPassaggi(), rimediDelFermo(inElenco: true) and fermoPerLaPagina(), which hands them already split to the warning of the «Recalculate» button (prop fermo_del_piano, computed with conIPassaggiCalcolati()). The refusals of issuing and of its cancellation write the transfers as a list and the steps numbered in plain text (EmissioneRateController::elencoPuntato(), passiNumerati(): blank line, «• », «1. »), which the plan page reads with resources/js/lib/gestionale/pianiRate/blocchiMessaggio.ts. In the transfer log: version 2, piani_presi (written at registration, also with the waiver; empty for transfers without a settlement, Subentro::haUnConguaglio()), regolato_fuori (per management, with the waiver or with the cancellation of the settlement). For transfers without piani_presi (recorded before this version) the previous rule applies, applied at the time of the transfer (scritturaEntro(), presoSoloInParteDa()). Rata::aGiornale() for «issued». Tests: StatoDelPianoDopoPassaggioTest, UsufruttoRigheSommateTest, QuotaDelPassaggioTest, CreazionePianoRateIngressoTest, the grid of transfer invariants with the recalculation before issuing; vitest of the Wallet modal and of blocchiMessaggio.
